item.title: Enterprise murder suspect to stay behind bars
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- An Enterprise man facing a murder charge must stay behind bars while he awaits trial. item.title: Claudette Colvin, who refused to move seats on a bus at start of civil rights movement, dies at 86
item.description: Claudette Colvin, whose 1955 arrest for refusing to give up her seat on a segregated Montgomery bus helped spark the modern civil rights movement, has died. She was 86.
